text:
Unfortunately, yes. DOA reports have to be made within 48 hours of delivery, and at 3 days you're past that window. Plant issues after that go through our Plant Care Guarantee, which covers you for 30 days from delivery (90 days if you're a Leafy Plus member and ordered while your membership was active).

To claim, go to "My Orders" and submit at least two photos (the whole plant and a close-up of the damage). A Plant Care Specialist will review it within 2 business days, and you don't need to send the plant back. If approved, you get one free replacement of the same plant, or store credit if it's out of stock. I can't promise the outcome, since the specialist makes that call.

I'm sorry about the plant. If you'd like to ask for an exception to the 48-hour DOA window, I can escalate that, but the guarantee claim is your quickest route.
